sloka: ते चास्य हयमुख्येषु तूर्णमुत्प्लुत्य वानराः।चतुर्षु समहावीर्या निपेतुर्भीमविक्रमाः ।। ६.९०.५० ।।
transliteration: te cāsya hayamukhyeṣu tūrṇamutplutya vānarāḥ।caturṣu samahāvīryā nipeturbhīmavikramāḥ ।। 6.90.50 ।।

translations.english: Those Vanaras of huge mountain forms getting on top of those horses (of Indrajith),
